decisions.reason: The area-elastic system has not shown sufficient market traction and sits outside the style-led interior focus, so the option is unlikely to pay off and should be dropped.
A mobile arena floor is complex and niche with high keeping costs and little evidence of value, so the option is abandoned.
This duplicate mobile arena system faces the same high uncertainty and cost without a distinct strategic role, so it is dropped.
Chevron parquet is closely aligned with the firm's trend-led, style-oriented direction and has low residual uncertainty, so the option is kept open.
A squash-specific finish is very niche and after three years its value is unlikely to be realized, so it is dropped.
Oak skirting for sports floors depends on the sports-floor options being pruned and itself has low strategic fit, so it is dropped.
